kept: RFC 9111 4.4: a cache must invalidate the target URI after an unsafe request (PUT, POST, DELETE) gets a 2xx or 3xx reply. concern: A5 S5.3 clock choice for ordering events: practice
source: web search (standard): hybrid logical clocks, wall vs monotonic clock, skew, recommended practice
kept: Search summary only (gist): wall-clock stamps alone mislead for ordering (leap seconds and non-monotonic updates can go backwards); monotonic clocks suit durations on one machine only; a hybrid logical clock is a pair (physical time, logical counter) that tracks NTP time and keeps causality. Large skew makes the counter diverge; vendors bound skew (YugabyteDB: 500 ms). No single authoritative recommendation.
